archetypes.name: dyn-oos-prefix
archetypes.rationale: Auto-prefix logic depends on exact OOS body detection and title normalization ordering.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the `issue create-one` path for OOS auto-prefix correctness. Focus on whether body redaction, explicit `--title-prefix`, and already-prefixed titles produce deterministic `ISSUE_TITLE` output without widening detection to ordinary issues. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
